excerpt.zh: 远古的先驱帝国[LastKilledCountryName]终于败在了敌人手中。这个曾经伟大的帝国之陨落将产生什么样的后果仍然不得而知。
excerpt.en: The ancient precursor state of [LastKilledCountryName] has met its final demise at the hands of its enemies. What the fall of this once great empire will mean for galactic politics remains to be seen.
